title: SimulateMedicalData (Tabular GAN for Medical Data Synthesis)
summary: A script-based project that trains a CTGAN model on tabular medical data to generate privacy-preserving synthetic patient records, evaluate their statistical fidelity, and test machine-learning utility. It imports CTGAN and evaluate from SDV's sdv.tabular and sdv.evaluation modules to run the synthesizer and score the synthetic output.
